verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms an llms.txt (HTTP 200) at help.reclaim.ai that indexes the help center. Many cited help articles are served as markdown (.md URLs), so an agent can ingest the docs directly. Missing for 10: any first-party documentation or announcement of the agent-oriented docs, an llms-full.txt or API-level agent docs (the OpenAPI probes all returned 404), a working docs-root markdown index (/en/.md returned 404), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
